{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative or neutral, especially after recent spikes.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent price declines (last 5-7 days) when sentiment is bearish.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above true outcome for 3+ consecutive days, reduce by 5-10%.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoot after sharp upward moves (e.g., >10% spike) by 15-25% in next 3-5 days.",
    "When sentiment is positive and price is trending upward, slightly increase forecast lag by 1-2 days to avoid overreaction.",
    "If true outcome consistently underperforms forecast (e.g., >10% error over 5 days), reduce forecast by 5-10% for next period.",
    "Use sentiment as a multiplier: if sentiment > 0.5, increase forecast by 3-5%; if sentiment < -0.5, decrease by 3-5%."
  ]
}
